messages:
Maria_CS: Hey team — Borealis account flagged a potential renewal risk. They've reported 15-20% timeout rate on chat completions after last week's model bump. Short thread with logs.
Sam_ML: Do we have perf traces? which model variant are they pinned to?
Maria_CS: They're on rwd-v2-large (pinned). SLA shows spikes at 99th pct during peak hours. Core ask: reduce tail latency without harming quality. Renewal workshop Thurs.
Riley_Eng: Quick thought: try int8 quant + route a compact fallback (rwd-v2-mid) for long-tail requests. Can canary for 48h.
Sam_ML: Agreed. int8 quantization has ~2.5x throughput uplift on similar hardware for this model family. Need to run QA evals on recent prompt set (esp. instruction-following cases).
Maria_CS: Customer is ok with small eval risk if we share rollback plan. They care about cost too.
Sam_ML: I'll run a targeted eval against Borealis prompt set. ETA 6–8 hours. If top-line quality delta < 2% on ROUGE/Exact we greenlight.
Riley_Eng: For canary, propose routing policy:
```json
{"route_policy":"prefers_low_latency","fallback":"rwd-v2-mid","weights":{"rwd-v2-large":0.7,"rwd-v2-mid":0.3}}
```
I'll add a prefix cache for repetitive prompts and bump batch_timeout to 10ms for this tenant.
Maria_CS: Nice. We'll notify the customer and set expectations.
Tess_Support: Capturing feedback from their PM: "We see the longest tails on long-system prompts and multi-step tool calls" — flagged.
Sam_ML: Good note. I'll include those prompt types in the eval harness.
Riley_Eng: Deploy-bot: small canary deployment set up now.
deploy-bot: Canary created: canary_id=cny-3467; target=10% traffic; start=2026-03-23T14:20:00Z
Maria_CS: I'll schedule the Thursday workshop but push it back if we need more data. Also, can we add token-level cost delta to the report so the customer can see cost/latency tradeoff?
Sam_ML: Yes — I'll output cost_profile.csv and a short note about expected savings.
Riley_Eng: If canary looks good after 24h, we can expand to 50% and then 100% within 48–72h. Rollback command if needed:
`redwood rollout cancel --canary cny-3467`
Tess_Support: Captured in ticket RED-7192. I'll update the CS playbook with rollout steps and messaging.
Maria_CS: Perfect. Post-mortem checklist: quality metrics, latency p99, token-cost, customer sentiment. Thanks team :pray:
Sam_ML: Starting eval now. Will update with numbers.
Riley_Eng: Monitoring hooks added (trace ids + span sampling). Alert if p99 > 1.5s.
Maria_CS: Last: customer asked for an executive summary for Thu — can we have a 1-pager by EOD today?
Sam_ML: I'll draft the summary after the eval completes.
Maria_CS: Great — moving this to active. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
